newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index slightly up in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index slightly up in active trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed slightly up by 0.09 percent in higher trade boosted by over-the-counter exchanges, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 504.73 from 504.27 points on Wednesday.
Total volume was 7.01 million dinars against 6.04 million dinars.
Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 4.39 million dinars. Turnover on the first market was 1.17 million dinars with 50,151 shares changing hands.
BIAT bank which plans to increase its capital by 20 million dinars to 80 million dinars and is to hold its annual general assembly on May 14 was up 0.44 dinar to 37.14 dinars.
Milk firm Tunisie Lait rose 0.7 dinar to 24.1 dinars. Airliner Tunis Air advanced 0.4 dinar to 24.4 with 9,149 shares changing hands. Arab Tunisian Bank edged higher 0.3 dinar to 32.32 dinars.
Banque de l'Habitat was down 0.6 dinar to 20 dinars. BTQI bank eased 0.38 dinar to 22.8 dinars. UBCI bank slid 0.3 dinar to 51.98.
STB bank was unchanged at 19.2 dinars with 11,862 shares changing hands.
